research.description: Read-only research and synthesis. No canvas or repository writes.

design-review.description: Read-only Figma/code review. Screenshots and metadata are allowed; writes are not.

figma-write.description: Figma authoring mode. Figma writes are allowed and should be preceded by figma-use when use_figma is used.

prototype-build.description: Code prototype mode. File edits, commands, screenshots, and prototype capture are expected.

memory-maintenance.description: Memory write mode. Canonical Core + Archive files should be updated and validated.

spec.description: Specification generation mode. Repository/spec writes are allowed; Figma writes are optional.
